verdict.rationale: Choosing a data-storage region is a fair question for a cloud calendar service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a region or data-residency control for Google Calendar. The Workspace pricing items mention a migration tool and booking pages, and the community posts raise general privacy worries, but none of these is a residency option.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
